name: Can I add an ADU to a custom home project in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: Is it possible to combine a custom home build with an accessory dwelling unit?
mainEntity.text: Is it possible to combine a custom home build with an accessory dwelling unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Combining a custom home with an ADU can be a smart way to maximize a Los Angeles property, but it requires careful planning from the start. The team needs to evaluate zoning, setbacks, lot coverage, access, utilities, privacy, and the way both structures will be served by driveways and services. On some lots, the ADU can be integrated cleanly; on others, it may create design or permitting conflicts. The biggest mistake is treating the ADU as an afterthought. If both structures are planned together early, the site can be used more efficiently and the project can avoid redesign later. Homeowners should ask whether the proposed layout preserves future flexibility and keeps the permitting path clear.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, many Los Angeles properties can combine a custom home with an ADU, but zoning, setbacks, lot coverage, parking, and utility planning must all be checked early. Combining both can improve site efficiency if the lot supports it.
